canon_requests.new: **Second Edition** (`mode.second_edition`, owner 14; DECISIONS 100 to 108, 117). An Ur-Text victory of a Standard or Abridged run may continue into 15 Second Edition Folios (doc 14 §8.9). Second Edition Folio `n = 1..=15` is run Folio `f = f_ur + n`, where `f_ur` is the Ur-Text Folio's index; `EntityId`s, uids and per-Folio streams use `f`. Folio `n` is in Volume `6 + floor_div(n - 1, 5)`, its boss Folios are `n = 5, 10, 15`, each ending on a revised Editor, with the Author after the revised Editor of `n = 15`, and its depth `d = 25 + 2n` feeds `P`, `T`, `H`, `S`, `ilvl` and `enemy_level`. Each Folio is written in two fused genres (doc 12). Second Edition Folios are not Marginalia Folios.
canon_requests.why: DECISIONS 105, 106 and 117 set the Second Edition structure, depth and lattice rule, but Canon §13.7, §13.8 and §17.1 define depth, item level, FINAL_FOLIO, BOSS_FOLIOS, GENRE_REPEAT_RULE and ENH_CAP only for the main run, Abridged and Marginalia (Canon gaps item 4; doc 11 Canon gaps item 2).

canon_requests.old: FINAL_FOLIO: 25 (15 in Abridged), always `genre.ur_text`; BOSS_FOLIOS: (current row); GENRE_REPEAT_RULE: no genre twice in the same Volume; at most 3 appearances per run before Marginalia
canon_requests.new: `FINAL_FOLIO` becomes "25 (15 in Abridged), always `genre.ur_text`; a run continued into Second Edition ends at Folio `f_ur + 15` (doc 14 §8.9)"; `BOSS_FOLIOS` appends ", and Second Edition Folios `n = 5, 10, 15`"; `GENRE_REPEAT_RULE` becomes "no genre twice in the same Volume (in Second Edition, no fused pair twice in the same Volume); at most 3 appearances per run before Marginalia or Second Edition"
canon_requests.why: Same as the Second Edition paragraph: the run constants must admit the 15 Second Edition Folios, their boss Folios and the per-pair no-repeat rule of DECISIONS 117 (Canon gaps item 4).

canon_requests.old: `ENH_CAP = 15` in the main run and `15 + floor_div(d_current - 25, 5)` in Marginalia; sets `ilvl = max(ilvl, current Folio index)`
canon_requests.new: `ENH_CAP = 15` while `d_current <= 25` and `15 + floor_div(d_current - 25, 5)` above it (Marginalia and Second Edition); sets `ilvl = max(ilvl, d_current)`
canon_requests.why: Second Edition Folios run at depth 27 to 55 while their Folio index is f_ur + n, so the cap and the Emendation ilvl must follow the depth, not the index (Canon gaps item 4; doc 14 §8.9 Folios).

canon_requests.old: Item level `ilvl` is the Folio index where the item was generated: 1 to 25 for the main run, 26 or more in Marginalia
canon_requests.new: Item level `ilvl` is the depth `d(f)` (doc 14 §3.1) of the Folio where the item was generated: 1 to 25 in the main run and Abridged, `f` in Marginalia, 27 to 55 in Second Edition
canon_requests.why: Abridged and Second Edition decouple depth from the Folio index; §13.8.2's gear_hp then applies to Second Edition armor through its ilvl unchanged (Canon gaps item 4).
